selection: All three geometrically in-domain official SOLRAD sites, before scoring; only STE has 2016 data in this campaign. No alternate boundary-nearest SURFRAD substitutes.
primary_reference: DNI * max(cos(supplied SZA),0) + DHI; all 60 QC0 minutes required, no PSP fallback
secondary_reference: Independent measured global PSP; separate metrics, all 60 QC0 minutes required
hour_classification: at least 30 of 60 observed minutes with SZA<90 degrees; fixed before calculating errors
protocol: Period-end minute samples (start,end]; no interpolation, shift, station/grid tuning or negative measured-irradiance clipping.
